label: PF Backlog 202
title: Backend: provider-kind abstraction + adapters/aggregators + kind-aware model router (all kinds)
body:
## Problem / why
Our model layer is text/chat-centric: one call shape, per-token cost. Media providers differ by KIND
and by async job shape, and span direct providers, aggregators, and self-host. Without an abstraction
the pipeline cannot route non-text models.

## Goal & value
A uniform, provider-agnostic layer so ANY model kind works e2e like text:
- a Provider/Adapter interface (submit/status/fetch/cancel/cost) covering sync + async,
- aggregator support (fal.ai/Replicate/kie.ai: one key, many models),
- a KIND-AWARE ROUTER that resolves models by kind + modality + cost + free/paid,
- mirrors the existing text path (tier -> agent model -> client).

## In scope
- Provider registry (direct | aggregator | self-host) + adapter registry.
- Adapter contract + async job handling (poll/webhook).
- Kind-aware router integrated with model_router / agent model resolution.
- Catalog fields: kind, provider_kind, billing_unit, unit_price, free, open_weights, license.

## Out of scope
- Generating the model list itself (BI-0188 adapters); media pipeline (BI-0187/0190); costing UI (BI-0194).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Resolve + call at least image-gen and tts through the router with a fake adapter; async path exercised.
- A text-only agent is unaffected; a media agent routes to a media model by kind.

## Dependencies & links
- epic BI-0185; BI-0188 (generator adapters); BI-0173 (catalog); BI-0192 (strategy picks kind/provider).

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: router picks by kind/modality/cost; adapter contract for a no-op + an async fake provider.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend provider/routing layer; no UI change.
